lesson: [EXAMPLE] Verify schema fields from the actual ORM/model file before assuming a column exists.
[EXAMPLE] For destructive file operations, state the target path and expected effect before execution.
[EXAMPLE] Do not refactor legacy modules unless the user explicitly includes them in scope.

All user-facing exceptions and error messages must be in Vietnamese with mandatory structured guidance: '[Tình trạng]. Nguyên nhân: [Nguyên nhân cụ thể]. Cách xử lý: [Chỉ dẫn khắc phục]'. Raw English technical driver/OS errors must only be logged and never leaked directly to user dialogs.

When refactoring or localizing Japanese text/data parsers, always preserve and apply NFKC Unicode normalization ('unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", ...)') so that full-width and half-width Japanese characters and digits (e.g. 'ＡＢＣ製造課' vs 'ABC製造課', '１４１２００００４０' vs '1412000040') match reliably.
In multi-line allocation rule loaders, continuation rows must inherit all account types from the item's first row, including sales_account alongside manufacturing and general accounts.

Exception localization tests must exercise and verify individual exception branches directly to ensure every branch produces 'Nguyên nhân:' and 'Cách xử lý:', rather than merely checking source file substrings.
